title: 前副总理纠正：是总理不是总统，加拿大为何如此敏感？
speaker: Christopher Freeland

segments.en: Okay, so first of all, Christina, and I want to say this in a nice Canadian way and not be a jerk.
segments.zh: 首先，克里斯蒂娜，我想用加拿大人友好的方式说，别显得刻薄。

segments.en: Canada has a Prime Minister, not a president, so it's Prime Minister Carney, and we have premiers and not governors, so it's the Canadian premiers you've been hearing about.
segments.zh: 加拿大有总理，不是总统，所以是卡尼总理。我们有省长，不是州长，你听到的是加拿大各省省长。

segments.en: I need to say that because otherwise your Canadian listeners will get mad at me.
segments.zh: 我必须这么说，否则你的加拿大听众会生我的气。

segments.en: I totally know you do, and I'm sorry to sound a jerkish, but Canadians will pay attention to that, especially now, Canadians are very sensitive.
segments.zh: 我完全知道你知道，抱歉听起来有点刻薄，但加拿大人会注意到这些，尤其是现在，加拿大人非常敏感。

segments.en: Look, I'm not privy to the inside details of the negotiation, and even if I were, it's not my place to reveal them.
segments.zh: 听着，我并不了解谈判的内部细节，即使了解，也不该由我透露。

segments.en: But what I will say is this. I think that there is a fundamental challenge here that we have to break out of to have a successful deal.
segments.zh: 但我要说的是，我认为这里有一个根本性挑战，我们必须突破才能达成成功的协议。
